title: Starter house lexicon (example data, extend it with your team's own words)

entries.name: dolly in
entries.means: The camera itself travels toward the subject, so the background shifts and the depth between objects changes.
entries.tell: Objects at different distances grow at different speeds; edges of the frame slide past.
entries.contrast: In a zoom in, everything grows at the same rate and the background looks squashed flatter.
entries.ask: Slow dolly in from a medium shot to a close-up of her hands over 4 s, ease-in-out, no zoom.

entries.name: zoom in
entries.means: The lens changes focal length while the camera stays put, so the whole picture is magnified evenly.
entries.tell: Foreground and background enlarge together; parallax is absent.
knobs: start and end focal length or scale
entries.ask: Zoom in from 1x to 1.6x over 2 s, linear, camera locked off.

entries.name: orbit
entries.means: The camera circles the subject at a steady distance, keeping it centred while the background wheels behind it.
entries.tell: The subject stays the same size; we see a different side of it as the background turns.
entries.contrast: In a turntable the object spins and the camera and background stay still.
entries.ask: Orbit 90° to the right around the coffee cup at table height over 5 s, ease-in-out.

entries.name: pan
entries.means: The camera stays in one spot and swivels left or right, like turning your head.
entries.tell: Near and far objects slide past at nearly the same angle; we never see around anything.
entries.ask: Pan from left to right across the skyline, 40°, 6 s, linear.

entries.name: mask reveal
entries.means: Text or an image slides out from behind an invisible edge, so it appears to emerge from a slot.
entries.tell: Letters are cut off by a straight line until fully out; nothing fades.
cues: slides up from behind a line
entries.ask: Mask reveal each title line from below, 0.6 s per line, 80 ms stagger, ease-out.

entries.name: typewriter
entries.means: Characters appear one at a time in reading order, often with a blinking caret at the end.
entries.tell: Each character pops in whole, at a steady rhythm, left to right.
entries.ask: Typewriter the tagline at 18 characters per second, caret on, hold 1.5 s at the end.

entries.name: count-up
entries.means: A figure climbs from a start value to its final value so the viewer feels the size of the number.
entries.tell: Digits change rapidly then settle; the last digits slow down before stopping.
entries.ask: Count-up from 0 to 12,400 over 1.2 s, ease-out, thousands separator on.

entries.name: skeleton screen
entries.means: Grey blocks shaped like the coming content hold its place while data loads.
entries.tell: The layout is visible before any text or images arrive, often with a soft shimmer.
entries.ask: Skeleton screen for the feed card with a 1.4 s shimmer, shown for at least 300 ms.

entries.name: sticky header shrink
entries.means: The page header stays pinned at the top and compacts as you scroll down.
entries.tell: The logo and bar get smaller after the first scroll and stay visible.
entries.ask: Sticky header shrink from 88 px to 56 px after 120 px of scroll, 200 ms, ease-out.

entries.name: rim light
entries.means: Light from behind the subject draws a bright outline that separates it from the background.
entries.tell: A thin glowing edge on hair and shoulders while the face is lit by something softer.
entries.contrast: In a silhouette the front is dark; with rim light the front is still lit.
entries.ask: Add a warm rim light from behind left at about 2x the key, 3200 K, face lit soft from the front.

entries.name: sidechain duck
entries.means: Music automatically drops in volume whenever the voice speaks, then comes back.
entries.tell: The bed dips under every sentence and swells in the gaps.
entries.ask: Sidechain duck the music under the voice by 8 dB, 50 ms attack, 400 ms release.

entries.name: match cut
entries.means: A cut between two shots that share a shape, motion or position, so the eye carries over the join.
entries.tell: Something round becomes something else round in the same spot of the frame.
cues: one thing turns into another on the cut
entries.ask: Match cut from the spinning coin to the turning wheel, both centred, cut at 2.0 s on the same rotation speed.
